facts.title: Rainier Cherry Mojito
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cane sugar or raw (turbinado) sugar
facts.author: Cookie and Kate

steps.text: In a mixing glass, thoroughly muddle cherries, mint, lime juice and sugar.
Stir the rum into the mixture.
Fill a collins glass with ice and pour your mixture into the glass. Top it off with club soda.
Mix by pouring the drink back into your mixing glass, then back into your drinking glass.

notes: Recipe inspired by Sprouted Kitchen’s rainier cherry muddler.
facts.summary: This rainier cherry mojito recipe is so refreshing. It’s a naturally sweet cocktail that’s perfect for hot summer days.
